description: Lightweight error reporting system that logs errors to Firestore collection 'error_logs' with global error handlers
steps: Create src/lib/errorReporting.ts - exports: reportError(error: Error, context?: { page?: string; userId?: string; extra?: Record<string, any> }): void. It should write to Firestore collection 'error_logs' with fields: message, stack, user_id, page (window.location.pathname), timestamp (serverTimestamp), device (navigator.userAgent), app_version (from package.json or env). Use fire-and-forget (catch errors silently). Include a shouldReport() check to avoid flooding (max 10 errors per minute from same client using a simple in-memory counter).

Enhance src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx - in componentDidCatch, call reportError() with the error and errorInfo. Pass user context if available (accept optional userId prop or use a static setter pattern).

Update src/main.tsx - add window.addEventListener('error', ...) and window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', ...) handlers that call reportError(). Register these before createRoot(). Also wrap the App render in the ErrorBoundary component.
Ensure the error reporting does not break the app if Firestore write fails (all writes are fire-and-forget with .catch(() => {}))
acceptance_criteria: reportError function writes to Firestore 'error_logs' collection
ErrorBoundary logs errors via reportError on catch
Global error and unhandledrejection handlers are registered in main.tsx
Error reporting is rate-limited (max 10/min) to prevent flooding
Logged data includes: message, stack, user_id, page, timestamp, device info
